The *Komāraputtajātaka* (Ja 299) is a narrative discourse preserved in the Jātaka collection of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. According to the traditional background framing, the story opens with the phrase "Aforetime you were used" and was delivered by the Buddha while dwelling at the Pubbārāma, occasioned by monks who exhibited rude and rough manners [SuttaCentral]. Four modern translations across four languages are recorded on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
